The target video is in the following style: Live-action photoreal with premium TV-drama image quality, fine film grain and natural skin texture, soft cinematic lighting with a side-backlight rimming shoulders and jawline, warm-neutral true-to-life palette.
[Shot 1] A close-up at eye level on <Subject 1> (Qin Jian), seated in the armchair opposite the crowd in <Subject 6>, softly backlit by the slanting dusk window light. The camera pushes in slowly as she lets out a small smile and answers in a low, rich, sultry young-adult female voice in the lower register, velvety and faintly husky, unhurried and languid in delivery yet every word lands with weight, coolly commanding with an effortless, worldly dominance, <d>[Chinese] 好，爷爷，您要评理，那我们就一件一件说，从谁开始？</d> with audible stress on "一件一件" and "从谁开始". As the line lands, the camera pulls back slowly to reveal the whole room: the relatives (<Subject 7>) glance at one another, nobody takes the question, and the smugness on <Subject 2> (Li Guifang)'s face recedes bit by bit into a tight, uneasy stillness that holds through the final frame.
